summary: Curate rows carry authors: names from lancet_authorships in byline order (seq, then name), [] when a work has none, never null. The authors lookup is one query per chunk of at most 500 work ids, not per row. The live fallback has no authors because its OpenAlex select requests no authorships, so it emits []. --output bibtex writes author = {A and B} right after the title, and omits the line when the list is empty.
reason: Callers could not cite or deduplicate curated works without the byline, and the BibTeX export was not importable as a citation without an author field. Authors live in a separate table, so they are fetched in batches; one placeholder per row would exceed SQLite's bound-variable limit on a large --limit.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/lancet/ and ./internal/cli/ assert seq ordering with out-of-order inserts and a NULL name, non-nil [] without authorships on every sort, authors "[]" in JSON for live rows, the BibTeX author line (present, right after title, absent when empty), and that 5 works with a chunk size of 2 take 3 queries and keep every work's authors exact. Tests: TestCurateFillsAuthorsOrderedBySeq, TestCurateEmptyAuthorsMarshalAsArray, TestCurateAuthorsOnEverySort, TestCurateAuthorsAreChunked, TestRenderCurateBibtexAuthors, TestCurateJSONEmitsEmptyAuthorsForLiveRows.
